benchmark.scope: Trigger callback and lifecycle CPU/promise overhead only; in-memory clock/verification/seek ports, no physical wait, serial I/O or printer acceptance.

behavior: After native drip trigger completion, schedule device PWM before recovery
Endstop verification occurs only after seek readback completes
Output failure or cancellation prevents coordinate reset and joins stop
No trigger callback on exhausted travel
Trigger raise uses current MCU time, not the future planned motion endpoint
Late or repeated callbacks cannot schedule duplicate or foreign commands
